Story: As a Data Lead, I want the accepted file ingested with only the 25 governed fields so that the pipeline is lean and auditable
As a Data Lead, I want the rejected file standardized (snake_case names, stripped %, parsed dates) so that funnel metrics are computable
As a Risk Analyst, I want documented cleaning and derived fields so that every number is reproducible
As a Data Lead, I want one script producing all samples and aggregates with a fixed seed so that outputs are rebuildable
As a Compliance Officer, I want a data-quality report on each run so that known issues are visible
As the Head of Credit, I want a governed KPI dictionary so that definitions stop drifting
As the Head of Credit, I want a documented rules catalog so that review criteria are defensible
As an Operations Manager, I want manual_review_flag computed per application so that queue volume is forecastable
As the Head of Credit, I want each rule's threshold backed by data evidence so that rules survive challenge
As an Operations Manager, I want a review-queue specification so that the future tool is buildable
As the Head of Credit, I want a 5-KPI executive overview with trends so that portfolio health is visible at a glance
As a Risk Analyst, I want charge-off views by grade x term, purpose, and vintage so that I can spot deteriorating cohorts
As the Head of Credit, I want accepted-vs-rejected profile comparisons so that policy thresholds are validated
As a Risk Analyst, I want year/grade/purpose/term filters and a public link so that analysis is self-serve
As the Sponsor, I want a written walkthrough and UAT support so that release is sign-off ready
As a Compliance Officer, I want a state-level concentration map so that geographic risk is reportable
